parameters.name: filter[location]
parameters.description: Return only units at this location, addressed by its KISS `location_id` (ULID).

parameters.name: filter[external_location_code]
parameters.description: Return only units at the location with this code in your own system. Company-token callers only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page to return. Paging details come back in `meta.pagination`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page. Defaults to 15, capped at 100.
